translationRepairs: After Shi Hu had invaded and withdrawn, Murong Huang still intended to expand his domain and sent the general Deng Heng with tens of thousands of men to camp at Le'an, making ready to attack and take new territory.
After Shi Hu had invaded and withdrawn, he still intended to annex Yan and sent the general Deng Heng with tens of thousands of men to camp at Le'an, making ready to attack and take new territory.
The subject of 猶有兼併之志 and 遣將鄧恆 is 石季龍 (Shi Hu); Deng Heng was his general, not Murong Huang's.
Murong Gen urged Jun, "What the prince says comes once in an age and must not be missed."
Muyu Gen urged Jun, "What the prince says comes once in an age and must not be missed."
The Chinese name is 慕輿根, surname Muyu, not Murong.
Murong Gen said to Jun, "The prince's words are a once-in-a-thousand-years moment and must not be lost."
Muyu Gen said to Jun, "The prince's words are a once-in-a-thousand-years moment and must not be lost."
The Chinese name is 慕輿根, surname Muyu, not Murong.
At that time Murong Wei held the throne and Murong Ke served as Grand Preceptor.
At that time Murong Wei held the throne and Murong Ke served as Grand Steward.
太宰 is Grand Steward (Taizai), not Grand Preceptor.
Chui told Rang, "I owe the emperor a boundless debt; I wished to send the Marquis of Changle with all his men to the capital, then restore my house and live at peace with Qin.
Chui told Rang, "I owe the emperor a boundless debt; I wished to send the Duke of Changle with all his men to the capital, then restore my house and live at peace with Qin.
長樂公 is the Duke (公) of Changle, Fu Pi's title, not a marquis.
The Marquis of Changle is the emperor's heir, his virtue beyond Tang and Wei, the pillar east of the mountains—he will not meekly yield you a hundred cities!
The Duke of Changle is the emperor's eldest son, his virtue beyond Tang and Wei, the pillar east of the mountains—he will not meekly yield you a hundred cities!
長樂公 is Duke of Changle; 元子 means eldest son.

Just then Fu Hui reported that the Dingling leader Zhai Bin had raised a host against Luoyang; Fu Pi told Chui, "The Bin brothers, exploiting our recent setback, dare rise in violence; mother and son together are a hard match—only your brilliance can break them.

Just then Fu Jian's general Fu Hui reported that the Dingling leader Zhai Bin had raised a host against Luoyang; Fu Pi told Chui, "Bin and his brothers, exploiting our recent setback, dare rise in violence; a mother-and-son force is a hard match—only your brilliance can break them.
堅將苻暉 identifies Fu Hui as Fu Jian's general; 斌兄弟 is Bin and his brothers.
I was ordered north and bound by the Marquis of Changle.
I was ordered north and bound by the Duke of Changle.
長樂 here is Fu Pi, Duke (公) of Changle.
I asked the Marquis of Changle to send all his men to the emperor and release them with honor; Pi clung to his obstinacy and would not bend.
I asked the Duke of Changle to send all his men to the emperor and release them with honor; Pi clung to his obstinacy and would not bend.
長樂公 is Duke of Changle.
At Luoyang the Plain Duke Fu Hui would not trust me.
At Luoyang Fu Hui, Duke of Pingyuan, would not trust me.
平原公 is the title Duke of Pingyuan, not a 'Plain Duke'.
Only for Changle and the Plain Duke, still young when they met you in the Two Capitals—we regret their counsel was not to our mind; that is all."
Only for Changle and Pingyuan, still young when they met you in the Two Capitals—we regret their counsel was not to our mind; that is all."
平原 is Fu Hui's fief Pingyuan.

He appointed his left chief clerk Guan Wei of Ku Ruo, right chief clerk Duan Chong, dragon-cavalry commander Zhang Chong, and the governor of Zhongshan Feng Heng as Minister of the Civil Office; Murong De as Attendant-in-Ordinary, commander of all armies inside and outside the realm, and colonel of the masters of writing; the Pacifying General Murong Lin as Grand General of the Guards; and the remainder received posts according to merit.

He appointed his left chief clerk Kuruguan Wei, right chief clerk Duan Chong, Dragon-Prancing General Zhang Chong, and the Governor of Zhongshan Feng Heng as Minister of Personnel; Murong De as Palace Attendant, Commander of All Armies Inside and Outside, and concurrently Colonel-Director of Retainers; the Pacifying General Murong Lin as Grand General of the Guards; and the rest received posts by rank.
庫辱官 is a compound surname (Kuruguan), not a place 'Ku Ruo'; 司隸校尉 is Colonel-Director of Retainers.
Chui smiled and said, "What can this boy do? I will be your butcher and kill him."
Chui smiled and said, "What can this brat do? I shall kill him for you all."
堅子 is a contemptuous 'brat', not Fu Jian.
Yong thought it a feint and pulled all his men back to guard Zhatai Pass.
Yong thought it a feint and pulled all his men back to guard the Taihang and Zhi passes.
太行軹關 refers to the Taihang passes and Zhi Pass, not a 'Zhatai Pass'.
